events.title: Maker Mondays - learn about 3D printing, laser cutting, electronics and more!
events.description: An open evening at Brisbane Makerspace to explore 3D printing, laser cutting, electronics, and various maker projects. It's a great opportunity to connect with the maker community and learn about new technologies.

events.title: KNOWONDER (Community event with workshops and keynote)
events.description: KNOWONDER is a full-day community event hosted by the School of Practical Philosophy, featuring workshops and a keynote address. It offers an intellectually stimulating experience with opportunities for learning and discussion.

events.title: HSBNE Night Tour (Public Open Night)
events.description: Visit HSBNE for their weekly public open night and guided tour, exploring Brisbane's largest community makerspace. Discover various projects from electronics to woodworking and connect with the hacker community.

events.title: HSBNE Day Tour (Public Open Day)
events.datetime: Sat 16 May, 10:00 AM – 1:00 PM (Tour at 11:00 AM)
events.description: A public open day at HSBNE Hackerspace, offering a chance to tour the facilities, see projects in action, and meet members of the maker community. Pizza is often served around lunchtime.

events.title: 3D Printing Workshop for Beginners
events.datetime: Check website for dates in May
events.description: Learn the fundamentals of 3D printing in this beginner-friendly workshop at Brisbane Makerspace. Get hands-on experience and understand the basics of design and operation.

events.title: Laser Cutting Workshop for Beginners
events.datetime: Check website for dates in May
events.description: Master the basics of laser cutting and design in this hands-on workshop at Brisbane Makerspace. Learn to safely operate a laser cutter and create your own projects.

events.title: Laser Cut LED Lamp Workshop
events.datetime: Check website for dates in May
events.description: Design and create your own unique LED lamp using laser cutting technology in this creative workshop. Perfect for those interested in hands-on design and electronics.

events.title: Brisbane Stoics May 2026 Meetup - Seneca, Letter 66
events.description: Join the Brisbane Stoics for their monthly meetup, discussing Seneca's Letter 66 in a community-oriented philosophy group. Engage in thoughtful conversation and explore Stoic principles.

events.title: Brisbane Social and Language Exchange (Make New Friends)
events.description: A weekly social gathering to practice languages, meet new people, and make international friends in a relaxed pub setting. This community-oriented event fosters cultural exchange and conversation.

events.title: Saturday Social: Drink & Make International Friends - Explore Language & Culture
events.link: Check Brisbane Social Club - International Friends Meetup group
events.description: This recurring Saturday social event offers a chance to meet international and local friends, practice languages, and explore different cultures in a casual pub environment. Perfect for open-minded conversation.

events.title: International and local language exchange Brisbane Meetup
events.source: International and local language exchange Brisbane
events.description: Join this regular Thursday meetup to connect with international and local residents, practice different languages, and make new friends. It's a relaxed setting for cultural and linguistic exchange.

events.title: Handmade Ring Making Workshop with Local Jeweller
events.datetime: Check website for dates in May
events.description: Learn the craft of jewellery making and create your own handmade ring with guidance from a local jeweller. This workshop offers a unique creative and hands-on experience.

events.title: Mosaic Art Classes - Turkish Lamp Workshop
events.datetime: Check website for dates in May
events.description: Engage in mosaic art and create a beautiful Turkish lamp in this hands-on class. Learn traditional techniques and design principles in a creative environment.

events.title: Matthew Newkirk: Distorted Image
events.description: Explore this solo exhibition by Matthew Newkirk at PARKER Contemporary, featuring works that delve into the concept of distorted images. The exhibition runs through late May and offers a chance to engage with contemporary art.

events.title: Botanical Meditation (Oxana Arefin Solo Exhibition)
events.datetime: Opens Fri 15 May, runs until 10 Jun
events.location: Creative Room Art Space, West End
events.description: Oxana Arefin presents a solo exhibition, 'Botanical Meditation,' exploring themes of nature and contemplation through art. The exhibition opens on May 15th and runs for several weeks at this independent art space.

events.title: Odessa Mahony-de Vries | 'Unbound'
events.description: Experience 'Unbound,' an exhibition by Odessa Mahony-de Vries, showcasing her latest works at Mitchell Fine Art. This is an opportunity to see contemporary art from an emerging artist.

events.title: Josh Thomas - Jiggle Jiggle
events.description: Award-winning comedian Josh Thomas brings his new show 'Jiggle Jiggle' to the Brisbane Powerhouse for a limited run. Expect his signature style of observational humor and witty storytelling.

events.title: Lloyd Langford - Okay, I Believe You
events.description: Welsh comedian Lloyd Langford performs his show 'Okay, I Believe You' at the Brisbane Powerhouse. Known for his dry wit and engaging style, this promises an evening of thoughtful comedy.

events.title: Hellions (10 Years of Opera Oblivia)
events.description: Celebrate 10 years of 'Opera Oblivia' with Hellions at The Triffid, a popular Brisbane venue for live music. Expect an energetic performance from this acclaimed band.

events.title: Rachael Fahim: Who You Are Tour with Lachie Gill & Ella Jones
events.description: Catch Rachael Fahim on her 'Who You Are Tour,' supported by Lachie Gill and Ella Jones, at the intimate Black Bear Lodge. Enjoy a night of live music in a cozy setting.

events.title: Luca Brasi
events.description: Experience Luca Brasi live at The Triffid, a popular venue for contemporary bands. Known for their energetic performances, this is a chance to see them in action.

events.title: Georgia Scarlett
events.description: Catch Georgia Scarlett live at The Triffid, offering an opportunity to enjoy a performance from this emerging artist in a live setting.

events.title: Ceramic Plates & Bowls Paint and Sip Classes
events.datetime: Check website for dates in May
events.description: Combine creativity and relaxation in a paint and sip class where you'll decorate ceramic plates and bowls. Enjoy a social atmosphere while engaging in a hands-on art activity.

events.title: Sparkling Diamond Pageant 2026
events.description: The Sparkling Diamond Pageant 2026 brings an evening of entertainment and competition to Black Bear Lodge. Details on the type of pageant are not specified, but expect a vibrant atmosphere.
